label: SYNTHETIC
verdict_rule: CAUGHT only when the covering tests were green on the clean tree and, with the control off, pytest exited 1 with a named failing test that lives in a covering file, passed at baseline, and is one of the killers the probe named in advance. A kill made only by a test the probe did not name is INVALID (killed by an unexpected watcher). A watcher that is missing, red, empty, or never reaches the mutated module makes the probe INVALID, never CAUGHT. Exits 2, 4, 5 and timeouts are INVALID.

method: each probe disables exactly one control in place, runs the tests that are supposed to cover it, and restores the file. A probe that SURVIVES means the suite passes with that control off, so nothing tests it. This is the oversight ablation argument applied to the test suite rather than the agent.
